editorial.blurb: CHICHA San Chen brings a refined tea experience to Chinatown, where carefully sourced high-elevation leaves are brewed to order with the precision of specialty coffee.
editorial.insiderTip: Sign up for the complimentary 20-minute tea tasting experience at the bar next to the register—Lee guides you through different brews while you wait for your order, and it's informative without being rushed.
signatureDishes: Hot Fruit Tea with Fresh Fruit
